artist.name: Fadescha
artist.bio: Fadescha is a DJ, artist and curator from New Delhi, working between Berlin and New Delhi, and a member of the Delhi collective Coven Code. Their DJ sets cover techno and house leaning towards acid, industrial and psychedelic sounds, and they host Party Office, an art and social space in New Delhi.
